## 📝 Summary

<!--
A short description of what this PR changes and *why*. The diff already
shows the what — focus the summary on the motivation, root cause, or
threat model. Link the related issue with `Fixes #123` / `Refs #123`.
-->

## 🧪 Test plan

<!--
How did you verify this works? Bullet the manual checks AND the automated tests.
Reviewers should be able to re-run the same verification if they need to.
-->

- [ ] 🔴🟢 Wrote a failing test first, then made it pass
- [ ] ✅ `npm test` is green for every package I touched
- [ ] 🏗️ `npm run build` succeeds for every package I touched
- [ ] 🛡️ `npm audit --audit-level=moderate` reports no findings
- [ ] 👀 Manually verified the change in the running app (if user-facing)

## 📚 Documentation

- [ ] 📘 README updated (if user-visible behaviour or deployment changed)
- [ ] 📗 `docs/Technical Documentation.md` updated (if architecture changed)
- [ ] 📦 `ATTRIBUTIONS.md` updated (if a dependency was added or removed)
- [ ] 💬 Code comments added for any non-obvious *why*

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] 🧩 Each commit is a single logical change with a body explaining *why*
- [ ] 🧼 No stray files, debug logging, or secrets in the diff
- [ ] 📖 I have read and follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
